name: LibraryApp
description: The Library app (photo catalog): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/LibraryApp, built from SuiteUI. Reads LibraryModel and calls its methods; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule).

reads state and calls its methods
